An evening of quality Urdu poetry - August 17th, 2014
The website with the largest collection of Urdu poems, Rekhta.org organized Sham-e-Sher, a heart-warming evening of quality Urdu poetry. On this occasion, India’s prominent entrepreneur and founder of Rekhta, Sanjiv Saraf spoke about Rekhta, the inauguration of which can be accredited to his keen interest in Urdu poetry. This interest led him to fulfill his dream of creating a website where Urdu poetry can be read in Urdu, Hindi as well as Roman scripts.
